verdict.rationale: Poly can be driven programmatically through documented interfaces. It runs a live hosted MCP server at mcp.poly.app/mcp with OAuth, exposing search, fetch and a virtual `poly` CLI as tools. It also ships a scriptable `poly` CLI with 25+ commands and an agent skill for composing them. However, no conventional public API spec could be found: every OpenAPI/Swagger probe path returned 404, so the API surface is limited to MCP and CLI wrappers. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose REST/HTTP API with an OpenAPI spec, API reference docs beyond MCP/CLI, independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven workflows.
